name: looks-menu
description: The menu row 'Load Looks' (Off / Load) in Custom Menu J, in the place of Touch Screen Settings (the E-PM2 has no touch screen). Its value is the dormant setting 449 (prm tag 0xD7B1, MODE bank, one byte, default 0, read by no stock code); its list is the stock Off / On panel 610 with 'On' shown as 'Load'. The loader of data/specs/card-looks-2.json reads the setting when the GUI leaves the menu and sets it back to Off (1; Load is 0, so that the value 1 that the firmware gives the setting at every start reads Off). An edit of one row and one child entry of the tables of data/specs/peaking-menu.json, the list of panel 610, and three English texts of built-in EVF panels (block 1). Other languages keep the old texts of these ids. See experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 9.5.

ops._note: Custom Menu item table of peaking-menu, row 78 (J, Touch Screen Settings: text 544, setting 427, help 1132, value list 0) -> {group 9, text 1498 'Load Looks', setting 449, order 4, help 1497, value list 610, 0}
Custom Menu child list of peaking-menu, entry 78: (panel 174, setting 427) -> (panel 610, setting 449)
panel 610, item 1 (Off): value 0 -> 1, the value the firmware gives setting 449 at every start (so a camera shows Off)
value -> text list of the row: 1 Off, 0 Load, end mark -15 (the layout of the stock Off/On list 0x7F012724)
